correctness.rationale: Lucas digits for m=2n and the carry state c=0,1 yield local complex weights 1,i,1 for produced digits 0,1,2. Parity of the count of digit-one positions makes the total product real ±1. Summing over free input digits gives M=[[2,i],[i,2]], eigenvalues 2±i and exact block count. Fixed higher digits have product norm <=sqrt2; aligned j-block signed sums are <=2*sqrt(5^j), giving a global geometrical prefix bound. Irrationality of arg(2+i)/pi follows because (3+4i)/5+(3−4i)/5=6/5 cannot be an algebraic-integer sum of roots of unity. Independent exact Lucas calculation through n<15625 and all blocks L<=6 verified the counts, not the infinite claim.
